items.name: WithMetricsReporterLayer
items.summary: Extension trait that adds [`with_metrics_reporter_layer`] to any compatible tracing subscriber.

methods.name: with_metrics_reporter_layer
methods.signature: fn with_metrics_reporter_layer(self, reporter: Arc<dyn MetricsReporter>) -> Layered<ReportGeneratorLayer, Self> where Self: Sized
methods.summary: Wrap this subscriber with a [`ReportGeneratorLayer`] that converts tracing spans into [`MetricEvent`]s and forwards them to `reporter`.
